description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for storing information about application deployments in a MongoDB collection named 'app_deployments'. It specifies the structure, data types, indexes, and constraints for deployment-related data such as app IDs, URLs, status, timestamps, and domain information.

classes.name: AppDeploymentsSchema
classes.description: Mongoose schema defining the structure and constraints for app deployment documents in MongoDB.

methods.name: mongoose.model
methods.description: Creates and exports the Mongoose model 'AppDeployment' based on the schema.
